product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Realyn Dining Room Upholstered Chair 2 Count, Antique White
features: UPHOLSTERED DINING CHAIRS: Your cottage eatery awaits with cushioning and plenty of stylized flair to please. You'll love how these chairs make an everyday eat-in kitchen or bistro special

HANDSOMELY CRAFTED: Chairs are made with engineered wood and wood solids, with a foam cushioned seat upholstered in polyester. Keep furniture away from heating and air conditioning sources to prevent loss of moisture; and avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading or darkening of wood
ALL IN THE DETAILS: Notice how the distressed, chippy white finish brings out the beauty of the ladderback design—for the height of French country-inspired style brought to the table
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Easy-to-follow instructions and hardware included
Note : To ensure proper assembly, please follow all steps provided in the installation manual (provided in pdf below)
